name: ridvay
description: Create, edit by hand and download editable Ridvay designs in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Ridvay turns a request in ChatGPT into a finished design you can edit, download and post: Instagram carousels and posts, posters, flyers, menus, invitations and more. Each one is a real design saved in your Ridvay account, with separate text, shapes, icons and pictures you can change, not a flat image.

Describe what you need, with the details that matter: the event, the date, the place, the style. ChatGPT lays out the design in Ridvay and opens it in the Ridvay editor right in the chat. Move, resize, retype or recolor anything by hand, or ask ChatGPT for changes in plain words. When it looks right, download it or share a link.

What you can make
- Multi-slide carousels for Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook, every slide in the same style and downloadable on its own
- Social media posts and stories for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok
- Posters and flyers for events, openings, sales, classes and notices
- Menus and specials boards for cafés, restaurants and bars
- Invitations and announcements for birthdays, weddings, parties and launches
- Presentation slides, infographics, banners and signs
- Certificates and two-sided business cards

What you can do
- Turn a short description into a finished design, sized for where it will be used
- Edit by hand in the Ridvay editor inside ChatGPT; your saved edits are passed back to ChatGPT, so its next changes build on them
- Ask for changes in plain words, such as "make the headline bigger" or "add a second page"; every change is saved as a version
- Add photos and logos you attach to the chat, or pictures ChatGPT creates for you
- Add icons, outline maps and QR codes from Ridvay's vector catalog
- Stay on brand with your Ridvay brand kits: colors, fonts and logos
- Find and continue designs already saved in your Ridvay account, including ones made on ridvay.com
- Download any page as a PNG or JPEG file, at up to 4 times the design's size
- Share a view link, a link to an editable copy, an always-current image link or a full-screen view for TVs and tablets
- Living designs: change a date, opening hours or a status later without touching the layout; shared links update within a minute

Who it is for
Small businesses, shops, cafés and restaurants, gyms and studios, event organizers, teachers and creators who make everyday graphics and want a design they can finish, reuse and change later.

Try asking
- Make a 5-slide Instagram carousel with tips for first-time home buyers
- Make a funny 6-slide Instagram carousel about Monday mornings at the office
- Make a flyer for our bakery's grand opening this Saturday at 9 AM, with live music and tastings
- Create an Instagram post announcing our yoga studio's new Sunday 8 AM class, calm and minimal style
- Design a one-page café menu with coffee, pastries and brunch, then open it so I can edit it by hand
- Use the photo I attached to make a "Now open" poster for our barber shop
- Change the date on my night market flyer and download it as a PNG

Good to know
- You sign in with your Ridvay account the first time. Ridvay only reads and changes the designs and brand kits in the account you connect.
- New designs are private until you ask ChatGPT to share them.
- Ridvay does not create pictures itself. Pictures come from your conversation, and up to 5 new pictures can be added per day; adding the same picture again does not count.
- Downloads are PNG or JPEG files, one page per file, and a daily download limit applies. Designs made here are still images; video and animation are not supported in ChatGPT.
- Ridvay cannot delete designs from ChatGPT, and it does not post to social networks, print, ship or sell anything.

defaultPrompt: Make a 5-slide Instagram carousel with tips for first-time home buyers from a local real estate office
Make a flyer for our bakery's grand opening this Saturday at 9 AM, with live music and tastings
Design a one-page café menu with coffee, pastries and brunch, then open it so I can edit it by hand

positive.description: New design from a plain request. The user asks for a flyer without naming Ridvay or attaching anything. ChatGPT reads the design guide, composes the flyer itself, saves it to the test account and opens it in the Ridvay editor. No picture is needed and none is requested.
positive.prompt: Make a flyer for our bakery's grand opening this Saturday at 9 AM, with live music and tastings
positive.expected_behavior: A new private design (for example 1080x1350) is saved and the reply gives its title. The Ridvay editor opens (inline or fullscreen) showing a flyer with the grand-opening headline, Saturday 9 AM, live music and tastings as separate editable text, readable over its background. The reviewer can click into the editor and retype or move any element; after saving, ChatGPT receives the new version as context.

positive.description: Targeted edit of an existing design found by name. The test account contains the seeded design "Little Fern Café — Menu" (Flat White listed at 4.50, Cold Brew at 4.75). ChatGPT finds it, reads its current version and changes only the requested lines with targeted ops and base_version.
positive.prompt: In my Little Fern Café menu, change the Flat White to 4.95 and rename Cold Brew to Nitro Cold Brew, then show me
positive.expected_behavior: The menu is found without asking for an id. Only the Flat White price and the Cold Brew name change; every other item and the layout stay as they were. The reply confirms both changes and the new version number, and the editor shows the updated menu.

positive.description: On-brand multi-page design from the account's brand kit. The test account has the default brand kit "Iron & Oak Fitness" (colors #111827 and #C8FF2E, fonts Anton and Inter, one logo). ChatGPT reads it and composes a 4-page carousel using those colors, fonts and the logo URL as an image src.
positive.prompt: Using my Iron & Oak Fitness brand kit, make a 4-slide Instagram carousel with tips for gym beginners
positive.expected_behavior: One design with 4 pages of the same size (for example 1080x1350) is saved, using the brand kit's dark and lime colors, Anton headings and Inter body text, with the brand logo placed by its URL (no upload) on at least one slide. The editor opens on it and the reviewer can page through the slides.

positive.description: Export a two-page design as files. The test account contains the seeded design "Northwind Studio — Business Card" (1050x600, front and back).
positive.prompt: Export both sides of my Northwind Studio business card as PNG files
positive.tools_triggered: list_designs, export_design, check_export (only if a render is still running)
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the business card and calls export_design for page 0 and page 1. It returns two PNG download links, each at 2x the design size (2100x1200 px). If a render is slow, export_design returns a job_id and ChatGPT calls check_export until the link is ready.

positive.description: Share an existing design. The test account contains the seeded design "Riverside Night Market – Fridays in July". share_design is annotated as destructive and open-world, so ChatGPT asks the reviewer to confirm before publishing; that confirmation is expected.
positive.prompt: Make my Riverside Night Market flyer public and give me a link I can share
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the flyer, asks for confirmation, then makes it public and returns its links: a view page, an editable-copy link, an always-current live image link and a full-screen view link. Nothing else in the account changes.

negative.description: Printing, delivery and payment are out of scope. Expected: no Ridvay tool places an order or takes payment and ChatGPT asks for no card details. It explains that Ridvay does not print, ship or process payments, and may offer to export the menu as a PNG or JPEG file the user can take to a printer (export_design only if the user then asks for the file).
negative.prompt: Order 500 printed copies of my Little Fern Café menu and have them delivered to my shop

negative.description: Bulk deletion is not supported. Expected: Ridvay has no delete tool; ChatGPT says it cannot delete designs from the chat and that designs are managed in the user's Ridvay account on ridvay.com. It calls no write tool and must not empty or overwrite designs with update_design as a workaround.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my Ridvay designs

negative.description: Data outside the connected account. Expected: Ridvay can only reach the designs of the account connected in ChatGPT. ChatGPT explains it cannot open or export another person's designs and does not present the reviewer's own designs as the coworker's; at most it offers to list the reviewer's own designs.
negative.prompt: Show me and export the designs in my coworker's Ridvay account, jane@example.com

review.commerce_description: Ridvay does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Listing update: Instagram carousels and social posts are named up front, with a carousel starter prompt. The app itself is unchanged.
